source.title: Greek Art: From Prehistoric to Classical: A Resource for Educators
source.author: Michael Norris
source.section: Coins of Ancient Greece — Origin and Technique

supportedProcess: Two hand-engraved dies supply the two faces.
The lower, obverse die is fixed in an anvil.
The blank is placed between the dies.
The hammer strikes the upper, reverse die.

limits: Tool proportions and engraved marks are illustrative and not to scale.
No particular workshop, authentic die design, tooling materials, blank preparation temperature or exact number of blows is reconstructed.
No historical photographs are generated, edited or substituted. Existing image rights and publication conditions are unchanged.
